# NOVARION model card — v1.0.2

> Decision support / educational purposes only. Not a substitute for formal diagnostic imaging.

*Generated by `scripts/model_card.py` from the bundle manifest and `results/` — do not edit by hand.*

## Model details

- **Version:** 1.0.2 (preprocessing 1.0.0); artifact manifest `790a8dece9e982a4…`; created 2026-10-12T15:29:24Z.
- **Four independent binary classifiers**, one per target (probabilities are not constrained to nest):

| Target | Deployed configuration (selected by inner CV on all 303, 1-SE rule) |
|---|---|
| Overall CAD (Cath) | `lr[penalty=l2,C=0.01]|fs=redundancy_reduced|cw=balanced` |
| LAD stenosis | `lr[penalty=elasticnet,C=0.1]|fs=redundancy_reduced|cw=none` |
| LCX stenosis | `xgboost[max_depth=2,n_estimators=100]|fs=full|cw=none` |
| RCA stenosis | `lr[penalty=elasticnet,C=0.1]|fs=redundancy_reduced|cw=none` |

- **Calibration:** Platt scaling on cross-fitted out-of-fold logits (slope guard a > 0).
- **Operating threshold (Layer A):** Youden's J on calibrated training-side OOF probabilities; every case always receives a binary prediction.
- **Model confidence (Layer B):** HIGH only inside a region whose Wilson-95% lower bound met the pre-registered PPV ≥ 0.90 / NPV ≥ 0.95 (n ≥ 15) on training-side OOF scores; forced LOW for UNKNOWN inputs or an atypical profile.
- **Explanations:** exactly additive contributions in calibrated log-odds (LR: linear SHAP; XGBoost/CatBoost: TreeSHAP; EBM: native terms), aggregated to registry features; additivity is tested.
- **Stability (dataset patients only):** 10th–90th percentile of 100 refit-bootstrap replicates of the fold model (outer-training rows only, threshold fixed); an interval straddling the threshold forces LOW with reason "unstable" (D-017). New cases have no interval.
- **Updates:** governed learning loop (D-018): verified outcomes only, forward holdout, pre-registered paired gate, human-approved promotion, hash-chained audit log. v1.0.2 serves the frozen v1.0.0 models unchanged; no learning-loop update has been promoted.
- **Libraries:** python 3.11.16, numpy 2.4.6, scikit-learn 1.9.1, xgboost 3.2.0, catboost 1.2.10, interpret 0.7.8.

## Intended use

Educational and research decision support: estimating the probability of the dataset's CAD and ≥50% LAD/LCX/RCA stenosis labels from routine clinical features, visualized on a reference 3D heart, for review by clinicians or clinical/research reviewers.

## Out of scope

Diagnosis; lesion location or severity (each vessel is tinted as a whole); test or treatment recommendations; causal interpretation of contributions; event or mortality risk; patient self-assessment; any population other than the source cohort without external validation.

## Data

Extension of Z-Alizadeh Sani dataset (UCI #411, CC BY 4.0): 303 patients, 55 predictors (demographic, history, examination, ECG, laboratory, echocardiography), labels Cath (overall CAD), LAD, LCX, RCA. Labels and their derivatives are never model inputs (leakage denylist, tested). Training-matrix hash `3864a1ab3cd78d72…`; source file hash `739343245c2ba578…`.

Nested cross-validation: outer stratified 5-fold × 5 repeats, inner 5-fold for model selection; thresholds and calibration chosen on training-side data only. **Table scope: outer-fold mean ± SD (25 folds).**

| Target | Prevalence | ROC-AUC | Balanced acc. | Sensitivity | Specificity | Brier | Cal. slope | Always-positive accuracy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Overall CAD (Cath) | 71.3% | 0.930 ± 0.035 | 0.860 ± 0.051 | 0.851 ± 0.063 | 0.869 ± 0.082 | 0.095 ± 0.027 | 1.103 ± 0.630 | 0.713 ± 0.007 |
| LAD stenosis | 58.4% | 0.838 ± 0.046 | 0.758 ± 0.044 | 0.836 ± 0.081 | 0.679 ± 0.093 | 0.161 ± 0.023 | 1.000 ± 0.390 | 0.584 ± 0.006 |
| LCX stenosis | 39.3% | 0.721 ± 0.067 | 0.666 ± 0.067 | 0.731 ± 0.153 | 0.601 ± 0.123 | 0.209 ± 0.021 | 1.116 ± 0.528 | 0.393 ± 0.005 |
| RCA stenosis | 37.6% | 0.736 ± 0.037 | 0.666 ± 0.042 | 0.712 ± 0.127 | 0.620 ± 0.102 | 0.200 ± 0.012 | 1.069 ± 0.494 | 0.376 ± 0.005 |

**Confidence tiers — scope: pooled OOF (prespecified repeat), bootstrap 95% CI.**

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Overall CAD (Cath) | 61.7% | 94.7% [91.1%–97.7%] | 0.0% | — | 38.3% |
| LAD stenosis | 0.0% | — | 0.0% | — | 100.0% |

No vessel model qualified a high-confidence region at the pre-registered targets; the targets were fixed before results and are not lowered (D-008). Every case still receives a binary prediction.

## Comparison with the guideline pretest score (CAD)

On the 273 patients with a chest-pain type, out-of-fold CAD AUC 0.935 vs 0.852 for the updated Diamond–Forrester score (ΔAUC +0.083 [0.042, 0.127]) and 0.890 for the same three inputs refit on the same folds (ΔAUC +0.045). Subgroup results by sex and age: `results/tables.md` Table 7; reporting checklist: `docs/tripod_ai.md`.

## Limitations

- Single public cohort of 303 patients (high CAD prevalence, 71%); PPV/NPV do not transfer to populations with different prevalence.
- Internal validation only; no external or temporal validation.
- Lower discrimination in patients aged 65 and over (Table 7), with wide intervals; no fairness claim is made.
- One discordant label record (D-001: LAD stenotic with Cath = Normal) is kept as published.
- Contributions are associations learned by the model, not causes; correlated features share credit.
- The 3D anatomy is a reference model (BodyParts3D), not a patient-specific reconstruction.

## Ethical considerations

Human-in-the-loop by design: a review note records that a person examined the basis of an output; there is no accept-diagnosis action. The hosted demo is for de-identified or synthetic data only; cases are stored only in the user's browser and the server keeps nothing.
